content: Melvin-Koushki says Ibn Turka's poetical output appears to have been very modest, that his pen name is ʿAlī (not Ṣābir, as some have wrongly said), and that it is not clear whether a full dīvān has been preserved, the poetry being scattered through his works (e.g. the R. Munāẓarāt-i Khams and R. Aṭvār-i Salāsa).
